summary.fa: چقدر تحرک لازم است، قدم زدن بعد از غذا، حرکت‌های قوت در خانه.
summary.ps: څومره حرکت ته اړتیا ده، له ډوډۍ وروسته ګرځېدل، په کور کې د ځواک حرکتونه.
summary.en: How much to move, walks after meals, strength moves at home.

text.fa: تحرک هر روزه قلب، عضلات و روحیه را قوی نگه می‌دارد و به خواب کمک می‌کند. کار در خانه و در زمین هم حساب می‌شود.
text.ps: هره ورځ حرکت زړه، عضلې او روحیه پیاوړې ساتي او له خوب سره مرسته کوي. په کور او پټي کې کار هم حسابېږي.
text.en: Moving every day keeps the heart, muscles and mood strong, and helps you sleep. Work in the house and the fields counts too.

text.fa: بزرگسالان: حد اقل روزی ۳۰ دقیقه، ۵ روز در هفته، طوری تحرک کنید که نفس تندتر شود اما هنوز بتوانید گپ بزنید. تا یک ساعت در روز از آن هم بهتر است.
text.ps: لویان: لږ تر لږه په ورځ کې ۳۰ دقیقې، په اونۍ کې ۵ ورځې، داسې حرکت وکړئ چې ساه مو چټکه شي خو بیا هم خبرې کولای شئ. په ورځ کې تر یو ساعت پورې لا ښه ده.
text.en: Adults: at least 30 minutes a day, 5 days a week, moving so you breathe faster but can still talk. Up to an hour a day is even better.

title.fa: کار خانه و پیاده‌روی حساب است
title.ps: د کور کار او ګرځېدل حسابېږي

text.fa: پیاده‌روی تند، آوردن آب، جاروب کردن، خمیر کردن و کار باغچه همه حساب می‌شوند. زنان می‌توانند با هم قدم بزنند یا در خانه تحرک کنند.
text.ps: چټک ګرځېدل، اوبه راوړل، جارو کول، اوړه اغږل او د باغچې کار ټول حسابېږي. ښځې کولای شي یوځای وګرځي، یا په کور کې حرکت وکړي.
text.en: Brisk walking, carrying water, sweeping, kneading dough and garden work all count. Women can walk together, or move at home.

title.fa: کمی قدم زدن بعد از غذا

text.fa: بعد از غذا، ۱۰ تا ۱۵ دقیقه قدم بزنید، حتی در حویلی، یا چند بار بنشینید و بلند شوید. این کار به بدن کمک می‌کند شکر غذا را مصرف کند.
text.ps: له ډوډۍ وروسته، ۱۰ تر ۱۵ دقیقې وګرځئ، حتی په انګړ کې، یا څو ځله کېنئ او پاڅئ. دا کار له بدن سره مرسته کوي چې د خوړو شکره وکاروي.
text.en: After eating, walk for 10 to 15 minutes, even around the yard, or sit down and stand up a few times. It helps the body use the sugar from the meal.

title.ps: د ځواک حرکتونه، په اونۍ کې ۲ ورځې

text.fa: روی یک بالشت بنشینید و ۱۰ بار بدون کمک دست‌ها بلند شوید. بعد دست‌ها را به دیوار بگذارید و ۱۰ بار بدن را به دیوار نزدیک و دور کنید. این را ۲ یا ۳ دور تکرار کنید.
text.ps: پر یوه بالښت کېنئ او ۱۰ ځله پرته له لاسونو پاڅئ. بیا لاسونه پر دېوال کېږدئ او ۱۰ ځله ځان دېوال ته نږدې او لرې کړئ. دا ۲ یا ۳ ځله تکرار کړئ.
text.en: Sit on a cushion and stand up 10 times without your hands. Then push away from a wall 10 times. Do this 2 or 3 times.

title.ps: زاړه خلک: د انډول تمرین وکړئ

text.fa: دیوار را بگیرید و روی یک پا بایستید تا ۱۰ بشمارید، بعد روی پای دیگر. اگر بیشتر روزها این کار را بکنید، از افتادن جلوگیری می‌کند.
text.ps: دېوال ونیسئ او پر یوه پښه ودرېږئ تر ۱۰ پورې وشمېرئ، بیا پر بله پښه. که ډېری ورځې یې وکړئ، د لوېدو مخه نیسي.
text.en: Hold a wall and stand on one foot while you count to 10, then on the other foot. Doing this most days helps prevent falls.

text.fa: شکر، نوشابهٔ شیرین، سرخ کردن و نمک کمتر، با غذاهایی که دارید.
text.ps: لږه بوره، خواږه څښاکونه، سره کول او مالګه، په هغو خوړو چې لرئ یې.
text.en: Less sugar, sweet drinks, frying and salt, using foods you already have.

text.fa: اگر حالتان خوب نیست، به بخش صحت بروید و «چه مشکلی دارید؟» را بزنید.
text.ps: که ځان ناروغه احساسوئ، د روغتیا برخې ته ولاړ شئ او «څه ستونزه لرئ؟» ووهئ.
text.en: If you feel unwell, go to Health and tap What is wrong?

sources: WHO guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour (2020): adults 150-300 minutes of moderate activity a week (more gives more benefit) plus muscle-strengthening on 2 or more days; older adults add balance training on 3 or more days; pregnant and postpartum women at least 150 minutes of moderate activity a week
Buffey et al., Sports Med 2022 (meta-analysis: light walking after meals lowers blood sugar); Reynolds et al., Diabetologia 2016 (10-minute walks after meals)
Sherrington et al., Cochrane Review 2019: exercise with balance training prevents falls in older people
NHS: Angina, and Heart attack (nhs.uk): chest pain on exertion that eases with rest needs a doctor soon; chest pain lasting more than a few minutes needs emergency care
review: Amount: WHO 2020 says adults 150 to 300 minutes of moderate activity a week (more is better), plus muscle-strengthening on 2 or more days. Mo's 'around 6 hours a week' fits the top of that; the page says 'at least 30 minutes a day, 5 days a week ... up to an hour a day is even better' and uses the talk test for 'moderate'.

Mo's 'walk or do air squats briefly after meals' is kept as 'walk 10 to 15 minutes, even around the yard, or sit down and stand up a few times' (Buffey 2022: light walking after meals lowers blood sugar). 'Squat' became 'sit down and stand up', which is easier to picture by ear.

Strength at home: sit-to-stand from a cushion and wall push-ups, 10 each, 2 or 3 rounds, 2 days a week (WHO 2020). Step pictures well-walk-after-meal, well-strength-home. No strength icon exists; 'people' used.

Women who may not go out: 'housework and walking count' (carrying water, sweeping, kneading dough, garden work) and 'women can walk together, or move at home'. Check this is acceptable wording for Samangan.
Older people: balance on one foot holding a wall (WHO 2020 for 65+, 3 or more days a week; Cochrane 2019 falls). Step picture well-balance.

Pregnancy: 'walking and daily work at a comfortable pace are good; do not start new hard exercise or lift heavy loads'. WHO 2020 recommends at least 150 minutes of moderate activity in pregnancy for women without complications; the heavy-lifting line is common counselling, not WHO wording. Pregnancy danger signs stay on pregnancy-danger (not linked here, to keep 1 link).

Safety alert is amber, 'clinic today': chest pain or tightness on exertion that eases with rest (possible angina), feeling faint or dizzy, much more breathless than usual, a very fast or uneven heartbeat. Chest pain lasting more than a few minutes, even at rest, is in a tip as 'hospital now, day or night', matching blood-pressure.urgent.chest. Please check this split, and whether exertional chest pain should be urgent (red) for this setting, where a clinic visit 'today' is hard.
One link only (heart-food), to keep the narration near 2.5 minutes. Diabetes could be a second link (walking after meals).
Words to check: Dari تحرک (being active), بالشت (cushion)، حویلی، کلان‌سالان، تعادل، سرچرخی، ضربان قلب؛ Pashto انډول (balance)، اوړه اغږل (kneading dough)، انګړ، درزا (heartbeat)، بالښت.

Home tab rule (Mo): removed the pregnancy step (limits in pregnancy), the 'clinic today' box (chest pain, faint, breathless, fast heartbeat) and the heart-attack tip. Ends with 'If you feel unwell, go to Health and tap What is wrong?'.
